system.description:
Words and feelings flow freely from you. When the muse strikes you pour out emotion and stirring imagery, conveying message and meaning in art from symphonies to poetry, and whatever you write is clear and moving.

You can sink true Expression into a work; pieces created with Expression x3 or more have the potential to entrance Toreador, as per their clan weakness. Expression most often focuses on literary works, as opposed to Performance (before an audience) or Crafts (physical objects).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
